newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Lower House passes holding company bill.
newsitem.headline: Japan Lower House passes holding company bill.

text.p: Japan's Lower House of parliament passed a bill to lift a decades-long ban on holding companies, parliamentary officials said on Thursday.
The bill will be sent to the Upper House for debate and is likely to be passed into law next month, the officials said.
The bill will allow the establishment of holding companies in principle, except for those which would result in excessive concentration of power in some business areas.
The Fair Trade Commission will set up guidelines on rules governing the establishment of holding companies, the officials said.
